newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian bond exchange auction totals 14.4 bln Bfr.
newsitem.headline: Belgian bond exchange auction totals 14.4 bln Bfr.

text.p: An exchange auction of Belgian linear bonds (OLOs) totalled 14.4 billion francs, the Treasury said in a statement.
The Treasury offered OLOs 17 (6.25 pct,Nov 1996) and 22 (7.50 pct,Jan 1997) against OLOs 11 (9.00 pct,July 1998), 13 (7.00 pct,April 1999), 25 (5.00 pct,March 2001) and 26 (6.25 pct,March 2007).
The exchange of OLO 17 for 13 totalled 2.84 billion francs; that for OLO 17/25 totalled 5.06 billion francs; while OLO 17/26 totalled 6.50 billion francs.
